verdict.rationale: BVNK is API-first. Programmatic Hawk-authenticated API keys let scripts call it non-interactively. A sandbox that mirrors production, with simulation endpoints such as POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation, supports automated testing of integrations, and mandatory idempotency suits automated pipelines. A probe also found an official CLI repo (bvnk/agent-wallet-cli), though its content is undocumented here. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless guidance (env-var credentials, non-interactive CLI flags, CI examples), documented CLI capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
